cohort: 200 pregnant women (100 overweight and 100 normal weight) with gestational age between 8-40 weeks
finding: Overweight pregnant women had a significantly higher frequency of pre-eclampsia, PIH, gestational diabetes mellitus, prolonged labor, Caesarean section, wound infection, postpartum hemorrhage, stillbirth, early neonatal death, and NICU admission compared to normal weight pregnant women.
mod_finding: Overweight pregnant women had a significantly higher frequency of Caesarean section compared to normal weight pregnant women.
